incomeAssessment.scope: Targeted LA/Orange joint private care payments, food/housing/transport assistance and participant/caregiver resource costs; partial clinical reference retained.
incomeAssessment.rationale: Current fee and assistance pathways are real, but retained amounts, actual alternative private payments and matching unique household incidence are unidentified. Clinic counts and pharmacy revenue do not supply this financial cohort.
directions: Fees and full access/time/caregiver burdens may reduce resources even when clinical response is zero; supported transport and displaced purchases may improve them.
Joint household gains need net taxes/benefit withdrawals, finite delivery and additionality against existing insurance, Ryan White and other providers.
Positive overlap limits gains only; full negative costs remain, and public payer financing and real-resource costs are separate.
Broader work effects and the ordinary-gift full portfolio remain unquantified, not zero; no survivor earnings or retail drug value added.
